title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Scheduling Standards: Lead Time, Arrival Windows and Saturday Delivery
content:
For Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery, the earliest delivery date a booking can take is a set number of business days after the booking is made; the customer is given an arrival window of a set number of hours; and Saturday delivery is offered at some service levels, with a surcharge where one applies.

## Standards by service level

| Service level | Business days between booking and earliest delivery date | Arrival window given | Saturday delivery offered | Saturday surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | 2 | 8 hours | No | Not applicable |
| Threshold Delivery | 2 | 4 hours | Yes | $25.00 |
| Room of Choice Delivery | 3 | 4 hours | Yes | $25.00 |
| White Glove Delivery | 3 | 4 hours | Yes | $25.00 |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | 5 | 4 hours | Yes | $25.00 |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | 5 | 2 hours | Yes | $0.00 |

## Terms used

- **Lead time** is counted in business days from the date the booking is made to the earliest delivery date; it is a whole number of business days.
- **Arrival window** is the length, in whole hours, of the window given to the customer for the team's arrival.
- **Saturday surcharge** is in US dollars to the cent and is charged for a Saturday delivery date. Curbside Delivery does not offer Saturday delivery, so it has no Saturday surcharge; Premier White Glove with Haul-Away offers Saturday delivery with a surcharge of $0.00.

## Points of comparison

- With a lead time of 2 business days, the earliest delivery date is the second business day after the booking date; the first business day after it is too early. With 5 business days, the fifth business day after the booking date is the earliest, and the fourth is too early.
- The arrival window narrows from 8 hours at Curbside Delivery to 4 hours at the middle four levels and 2 hours at Premier White Glove with Haul-Away.
